audio_capability_profile.commit_expiry: text-ownership seal atomic at accepted-final arrival (final_wall) same session clock; pending requests partition subsequently accepted tokens through seal
audio_capability_profile.deadline: final_wall per timed-text session; identical across arms
audio_capability_profile.mutable_unit: accepted-text word group (whole words; straddlers intact+uncertain)
audio_capability_profile.operation: research-only pre-translation pending boundary on accepted text
audio_capability_profile.provisional_visible: out of scope; visible commit never rewritten
audio_capability_profile.source_clock: file samples at 16kHz; token end_ms maps to p0 + round(ms*16) (estimate)
audio_capability_profile.timing_preserved: provider token end_ms + arrival_wall + session_open_s on one measured clock

audio_input_to_psem.capture: single continuous Soniox session per case (stt-rt-v5, chunk512, realtime32ms, trailing100ms, one finalize; no hold/preroll/split)
audio_input_to_psem.spans: valid/missing/discontinuous from stored session join; R2 AB [680352,685472] joins to zero frames (invalid support, predeclared)

psem_observation_request.confirmation: 1600 samples (100ms); correct-transition control = annotation boundary + 100ms support
psem_observation_request.event_policy: F0 tau 0.5 on sigmoid(f0_raw); H7301 H100-C tau 0.5887844788775033 on sigmoid(cand_raw); first-event per episode via frontier_sweep.simulate_episode
psem_observation_request.reference: stored GT-derived/oracle-mapped single scope; never re-enrolled
